title: AI Engineer
description:
How you can make your mark
   

  

 Make your mark for the innovative Artificial Intelligence (AI) program at Boskalis and contribute at the forefront of strategically integrating AI into our operations to drive efficiency. Our AI Strategy is designed to tackle business challenges within strategically defined themes on our assets, dredging and offshore vessels and our primary process, our tenders and projects.
   

  

 To achieve this ambition, we have positioned a new AI department of 20 people at a corporate level. The department is working on our AI portfolio created by our senior business leaders and validated by our Board of Management. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop and implement (Gen)AI solutions that fulfil business needs.
   

  

 This position will require a blend of technical expertise and a desire to understand our business needs. An enthusiastic motivation, drive and willingness to continuously keep learning. "We are looking for someone with proven experience in LLM integration and who remains curious about new developments."
   

  

**Your Responsibilities As AI Engineer**
 Focused on developing, building, deploying and implementing AI models (e.g. LLM and machine learning techniques) and solutions for various projects. Works closely together with the business data and domain expert and the Business Data engineer.
   

  

* Develop, build, and deploy. AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), including integration with vector databases, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and prompt engineering.
* Apply frameworks for building scalable and modular AI solutions.
* Take ownership of the quality and reliability of AI solutions.
* Collaborate with diverse stakeholders (including vessel\-related) to understand business requirements, translate them into technical AI solutions, and ensure effective communication to maintain alignment and progress.
* Continuously learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies in the (Gen)AI field.


**Your Qualities And Experience**
 You can move ahead as an AI engineer (\+5 years) if you have:
   

  

* Hands\-on experience and/ or certifications using Databricks and/or Azure AI foundry for LLM utilization, data processing, exploration, and AI development.
* Strong skills in Python in the context of building and integrating LLM\-based applications, including the use of vector databases (such as FAISS, Pinecone, or Azure Cognitive Search).
* Familiarity with frameworks like, LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Pydantic and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience in setting up RAG pipelines to combine contextual business data with generative AI.Experience with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum.
* A good command of written and spoken English.
* Understanding of the maritime industry is a pre.


 The following competences are also important for the AI engineer:
   

  

* Strong communication and collaboration skills and the ability to independently interact with end\-users.
* Empathy for the business context: understanding the end\-user's use case and actively thinking about how AI can deliver value in the short term.
* Ability to work independently on your own use case and translate technical possibilities into concrete solutions for business.
* A mindset geared towards continuous learning and curiosity for tackling new challenges.
* Ability to handle feedback and reset your course if needed.


 If you are excited about the opportunity to work on innovative AI projects and have the drive to make a significant impact, we would like to hear from you. Explain to us why your background and expertise make you the ideal candidate for our AI program and join us in shaping the future of Boskalis. Apply now and help us shape the future of our industry.
   

  

 We offer
   

  

**What You Can Expect**
* Rewarding conditions: A competitive salary and much more, including holiday allowance, holiday entitlement of 26 days (based on a full\-time contract), a non\-contributory pension scheme, collective schemes such as company health insurance and travel allowance.
* Career development: We have a professional career development track for AI roles. Develop yourself with (online) courses at our Boskalis academy, both on personal and professional AI development.
* The Boskalis Campus: Experience the unique Boskalis vibe at our Papendrecht site, complete with restaurants, sports fields, and a wharf where our vessels dock. We offer a state\-of\-the\-art auditorium, brainstorming rooms, an experience center for client meetings, and a barista corner where you can connect with colleagues.
* Young Boskalis: Are you under 36? Come and join Young Boskalis! Have fun and join in social and sports activities ranging from pub quizzes to yoga, bootcamps and an annual sailing boat race. Networking and knowledge sharing are a vital part of Young Boskalis as well.


**Extra information**
* Your team: Join the Corporate AI department, a young and diverse group of 22 AI engineers, AI Delivery leads, AI Data engineers, and change coordinators.
* Where you will work: For office\-based roles, depending on your preference and project stage, you work partly at home and partly in the office in Papendrecht in an attractive working environment.
* Full/part\-time job: Depending on what you prefer the position is full\-time (40\) or part\-time (32 hours a week)
* Next steps: Apply easily by completing the online application form. Interviews are held online or in the office. Once it’s clear we’re a good match, we’ll make you an offer – and look forward to welcoming you to the company.


**About Boskalis**
 Working at Boskalis is about creating new horizons and sustainable solutions. In a world where population growth, an increase of global trade, demand for (new) energy and climate change are driving forces, we challenge you to make your mark in finding innovative and relevant solutions for complex infrastructural and marine projects
   

  

 Within a vibrant company culture, you will be working as part of a diverse, international team of experts. We offer you the opportunity to realize your full personal potential and expand your professional career by creating new horizons. Together!
   

  

 Interested?
   

  

 We are more than happy to answer your questions about the position of AI Engineer. Please contact Tim Gouweleeuw, Corporate Recruiter, via tim.gouweleeuw@boskalis.com.
   

  

**Interested?** 
 Please apply by filling in your details and by uploading your cover letter and CV on our careers site.
   

  

**Disclaimer for Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies**

However, our recruitment process is not structured this way, at Boskalis we handle recruitment ourselves. Therefore we do not accept unsolicited applications or CVs from recruitment agencies. Any submission will be treated as a direct application.

**AI Engineer @ Astera Holdings** 




**Location:** 
 Remote (Preference for New York)
 



**Reports to:** 
 President and Chief Product Officer
 



**About Astera Holdings:** 




 Astera Holdings is a quantitative finance firm on a mission to build the "Renaissance Technologies of prediction markets." We are transforming this emerging category—where traders bet on real\-world event outcomes—from a speculative frontier into a rigorous, scientific asset class. We are looking for a rare breed of builder to co\-author this new chapter in quantitative finance.
 



 Our company operates on a synergistic, three\-pillar structure:
 


* **Astera Capital:** 
 Our institutional asset management arm, designed to generate absolute, uncorrelated returns by systematically exploiting market inefficiencies.
* **BetSmart:** 
 Our consumer\-facing DaaS application, which makes smart betting accessible.
* **Astera Analytics:** 
 Our premier B2B consulting partner, which deploys our core intelligence to solve complex enterprise challenges.



 Our culture is a
 **"Meritocracy of Minds,"** 
 defined by Radical Intellectual Honesty, a Scientific Approach to Everything, and Lean Intensity.
 



**The Opportunity** 




 This is a unique opportunity for a talented and product\-focused AI Engineer to build the intelligent systems that will define a new category of financial technology. You will be a foundational member of our central AI team, focused on designing and deploying the sophisticated, stateful AI agents that form the intelligent fabric of the Astera ecosystem.
 



 Your initial and primary mission will be the ground\-up creation of our flagship conversational AI agent—the primary interface through which our customers will access our proprietary intelligence. If you are passionate about building complex, agentic AI applications and want to see your work have a direct impact on both a consumer product and a quantitative trading platform, this role offers an unparalleled challenge.
 



**What You'll Build: The Agentic Core** 




 As an AI Engineer, you will be responsible for building the sophisticated AI agents and backend systems that power our products. You will have full ownership of the end\-to\-end development lifecycle for these critical components.
 


* **Agent Architecture \& Development:** 
 You will architect and build our flagship conversational AI agent from the ground up. This involves designing and implementing sophisticated multi\-agent systems where specialized LLMs collaborate to provide clear, reasoned explanations for complex quantitative insights. You will use modern agentic frameworks to manage the agent's complex, stateful, and cyclical workflows.
* **Intelligent Systems Development:** 
 You will build and maintain the secure, scalable backend APIs that serve proprietary quantitative insights to our consumer\-facing products. This includes the systems that deliver curated, data\-driven opportunities, as well as the APIs for our portfolio construction and capital allocation models.
* **Full\-Stack AI Integration:** 
 You will collaborate closely with our product, UI/UX, and front\-end teams to seamlessly integrate AI features into our consumer application, ensuring the complexity of the underlying models is abstracted into a simple and intuitive user experience.
* **Platform Contribution \& Generalization:** 
 As our core conversational agent matures, you will identify and abstract its key components (e.g., orchestration logic, state management) into reusable services for the firm's broader intelligence platform, increasing development velocity across the entire company.



**Who You Are: The Agent Builder** 



* **An Engineer from a Premier AI Environment:** 
 You have hands\-on experience building sophisticated AI systems or products at a world\-class AI\-native company (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind) or a top\-tier quantitative firm. You are excited to apply your expertise in a new, data\-rich domain.
* **A Proven Builder of Agentic Systems:** 
 You have proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying complex, multi\-turn, stateful AI agents using modern agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain). A portfolio demonstrating your ability to build non\-trivial agentic applications is required.
* **An Expert in Modern AI Architectures:** 
 You possess a deep, practical understanding of modern agentic architectures, including multi\-agent collaboration patterns (e.g., supervisor, network), state management in graphs, and the use of tools and APIs within agentic loops.
* **A Strong, Production\-Focused Software Engineer:** 
 You have strong, production\-level software engineering skills in Python, including extensive experience with modern web frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Flask), designing and building REST APIs, and working with databases (specifically NoSQL databases like MongoDB).
* **A Product\-Centric Collaborator:** 
 You have a product\-centric mindset with demonstrable experience working in agile teams to ship user\-facing features. The ability to translate user needs and product requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions is paramount.

 We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
 

 All engineers and researchers are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

 The post\-training team at xAI transforms powerful pre\-trained models to become steerable, versatile, and capable of understanding and addressing real\-world challenges.
 



 As a post\-training researcher/engineer, you will enhance the model's instruction\-following capability and general usefulness to fulfill our mission – developing AI systems that can accurately understand the universe, create new knowledge, and improve themselves through interactions.

* Creating and driving research agenda to advance model quality.

description:
**Role: AI Engineer
   

 Location: Houston, TX 77007
   

 Duration: Direct Hire

 Job Description:**
 We are seeking a talented AI Engineer with deep expertise in Large Language Model (LLM) engineering and design. The ideal candidate will be fluent in manipulating and integrating pre\-trained LLMs within complex codebases to tackle practical challenges in data extraction, processing, and interactive systems. This role prioritizes hands\-on application\—such as customizing LLMs for specific tasks, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and vision\-based workflows\—over building models from scratch. You'll focus on leveraging LLMs for solutions like advanced chatbots, natural language interfaces, semantic search, and creative problem\-solving across data\-intensive scenarios, while collaborating in a fast\-paced team to push our AI products forward.
   





**Key Responsibilities**


* Integrate and fine\-tune pre\-trained LLMs into our codebase using APIs, frameworks, and orchestration tools to enable features like natural language querying, automated summarization, and intelligent anomaly detection in data streams.
* Design, build, and optimize chatbot systems and conversational AI, incorporating LLMs for seamless user experiences, including multi\-turn dialogues, context\-aware responses, and integration with external data sources.
* Implement RAG architectures to enhance LLM performance by combining retrieval from vector databases with generation, enabling accurate responses grounded in large\-scale document corpora.
* Apply advanced LLM techniques\—such as prompt engineering, chain\-of\-thought prompting, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows\—to solve general problems like automating workflows, debugging data pipelines, or generating insights from unstructured inputs.
* Work with open\-source LLMs (e.g., Gemma, Llama) for local deployment and inference, optimizing for on\-premises or edge environments to ensure low\-latency performance and data sovereignty.
* Incorporate computer vision tasks, such as OCR for text extraction from images or documents, and broader CV techniques for processing visual data in hybrid LLM pipelines.
* Experiment iteratively with LLM configurations, hyperparameters, and embeddings to boost performance metrics like accuracy, latency, and cost\-efficiency in real\-world scenarios, including vector search optimizations.
* Maintain scalable codebase integrations, conduct thorough testing (e.g., unit tests for LLM outputs, A/B evaluations), and ensure compliance with AI best practices, including bias mitigation and data security.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on code reviews, rapid prototyping, and knowledge sharing, while leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development.




**Required Qualifications**

title: AI Engineer
description:
Mirai, a Scopely company based in Riyadh, is building transformative AI solutions focused on enhancing productivity, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making within the company's internal operations and enterprise platforms.
   

  

 Mirai is a subsidiary of Scopely, a global interactive entertainment and mobile\-first video game company, home to many top, award\-winning experiences such as "MONOPOLY GO!," "Star Trek™ Fleet Command," "Stumble Guys," "MARVEL Strike Force," and "Yahtzee® With Buddies," among others. **Requirements**
* Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered systems that support data\-driven analytics, intelligent automation, and enhanced productivity across enterprise operations.
* Take ownership of key projects or components—from ideation and prototyping to research and scalable, production\-ready deployment.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate product and business requirements into robust, AI\-driven features.
* Implement and optimize machine learning models using modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) for applications such as Conversational Analytics, Knowledge Bases, Workflow Automation, and AI\-powered enterprise solutions.
* Develop, document, and maintain scalable APIs (e.g., using FastAPI) and integrate AI solutions into enterprise backend systems and data pipelines.
* Ensure reliability and efficiency of deployed AI models through rigorous troubleshooting, testing, and optimization in production environments.
* Contribute to cloud\-native development workflows using Docker, Kubernetes, and platforms like AWS or GCP.
* Apply modern software engineering best practices including CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and version control to ensure high code quality and maintainability.
* Stay current with evolving AI technologies and industry trends and proactively share insights with the team.
* Mentor and support junior engineers and actively participate in architectural design discussions to drive innovation and excellence.


**Qualifications**
* 2\-5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or software development
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience with modern ML frameworks
* Practical experience building APIs and deploying models in production
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and container tools (Docker, K8s)
* Understanding of microservices, databases (SQL/NoSQL), and version control (Git)
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and communication skills


**BONUS POINTS**
* Experience with MLOps, reinforcement learning, or computer vision
* Contributions to open\-source projects or relevant publications
* Enthusiasm for AI innovation and Mirai's vision


**Benefits**
* VIP Medical insurance for employee and his parents
* Phone allowance
* Kids education allowance
* Gym allowance.

title: Data Scientist / AI Engineer
description:
### **Join our mission to fight climate change**


Do you want to be part of one of Europe’s fastest\-growing climate tech startups? We’re looking for a data scientist with a passion for building scalable data and AI solutions both to provide innovative solutions for our product, an innovative carbon management software solution, and to support internal workflows.


If you’re excited about building an economy where every company creates real impact for a sustainable world, and empowering companies to decarbonize while growing their business, we’d love to hear from you.

**THE ROLE**

### **Your mission:**


You have a strong passion for implementing innovative data solutions to solve business problems. You will play a pivotal role in identifying opportunities for innovative data and AI solutions both to bring new data centric features to our product and to support internal workflows. You will own the implementation of such solutions end to end from defining the solutions together with product managers and internal stakeholders to implementing them hands on yourself and bringing them live.


**What you'll do:**

* Identify opportunities for innovative data and AI solutions to drive innovation in how carbon management is done
* Identify opportunities for innovative data and AI solutions to support internal workflows and drive internal efficiency
* Build production ready data and AI solutions with a diverse set of tools for both our product and internal usage (e.g. Python, dbt, Dagster)
* Collaborate closely with product managers and software engineers to conceptualize the solution and bring it live in our product
* Write clean, production\-level Python code and manage deployments in line with best practices

### **We think you’ll thrive in this role if you**

* You’re passionate about identifying and implementing innovative data solutions
* You have a proven track record of building robust, scalable and easy to maintain data solutions in Python and are comfortable with building Python based microservices using tools such as fastAPI, Django or Flask
* You have experience in using a diverse set of machine learning techniques to solve business problems
* You have experience in using novel AI techniques, in particular LLMs/GenAI models, to solve business problems
* You’re eager to keep on top of the development of new AI models and use cases, and use the opportunities that open up as the technology progresses

### **Why Cozero?**


We’re building the first Climate ERP system for companies \- a software platform to measure, manage, and reduce corporate carbon emissions with confidence. Backed by €6\.5M Series A funding (led by Kvanted and ENV), we work with global leaders like Maersk, Nippon Express Europe, and DMG MORI.


At Cozero, we believe that great products are built by empowered teams. You’ll work closely with our co\-founders Fabian, Helen, and Tiago in a highly dynamic, multicultural, and purpose\-driven environment.

### **What we offer:**

* A remote\-first working environment with the option to work from our office at the heart of Berlin with access to innovation events of the German Mittelstand and the startup ecosystem
* 27 vacation days per year \+ National holidays
* Virtual meditation and wellness sessions
* Frequent team events and at least 2 offsites per year
* A one time 500€ home\-office equipment stipend
* A 500€ annual learning and development budget
* Monthly budget for coworking space for employees outside of Berlin
* Participation in Cozero’s Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP), to have direct involvement and impact on Cozero’s success
* A strong company culture focused on growth, collaboration and fighting climate change
* Access to startup \& accelerator programs, sustainability networks, and more

### **How to apply**


We strive to build a diverse, inclusive and collaborative workplace and we follow a fair, objective, and non\-discriminatory recruitment process. All applications will be considered for employment regardless of nationality, culture, or any other personal characteristics. If you need any special requirements during the interview process please do let us know.

 Deploy AI solutions on Azure cloud infrastructure. Does this sound like the perfect place for you? Then apply now and join us on our mission to make a lasting impact on the world through Artificial Intelligence.

We are looking for an exceptional Senior ML/AI Engineer who can take ownership of building and operating AI services that rely on large‑language models (LLMs) and custom machine‑learning models. You will join a cross‑functional team creating AI agents and chat‑based "copilot" experiences within the Workato ecosystem. We fine‑tune and prompt‑engineer existing models rather than training models from scratch.


* **Build and enhance AI services.** Design, build and extend AI services using foundation LLMs and custom models. Collaborate with product managers and researchers to translate high‑level requirements into robust Python services.
* **Fine‑tune and adapt models.** Select foundation models and fine\-tune them for specific downstream tasks; prepare and curate training datasets; experiment with prompt engineering and embeddings to improve model outputs. LLMOps covers data preparation, model training, monitoring, fine‑tuning and deployment.
* **Develop and operate ML/LLM pipelines.** Implement end‑to‑end pipelines for model evaluation, retraining, and deployment.
* **Production deployment \& integration.** Create and maintain APIs and microservices for model serving; build and maintain middleware layers integrating LLMs with existing systems.
* **Monitoring \& evaluation.** Establish monitoring for latency, throughput, hallucination rate, accuracy and cost; build dashboards; measure the quality of chat agents and copilots through metrics and A/B testing.

* Understanding of LLMOps components—data preparation, fine‑tuning, monitoring and deployment.
* Experience building and operating APIs and microservices for AI models, including instrumentation for performance and cost monitoring.
* Ability to develop evaluation metrics and benchmark tests; knowledge of LLM evaluation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI safety, bias detection and regulatory compliance.

### **Preferred skills**


* Knowledge of agentic architectures and multi‑agent systems; experience building chat‑based agents or copilots.
* Experience with open‑source LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and vector databases.
* Familiarity with metrics logging and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, ELK), and observability best‑practices.

**Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics**
------------------------------------------


* Strong written and spoken English; ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative team player who takes initiative and thrives in a dynamic startup environment.
* Adaptable mindset with willingness to switch tools or languages when needed.
* Analytical thinker with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation.

* Real\-time data streaming and processing
* Document processing and embedding generation workflows


**Frontend \& APIs**

* API design for LLM services and conversational interfaces
* Multiple protocols (HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets, MCP)

* Building high\-performance, scalable AI applications

* Performance monitoring, observability, and debugging production AI systems
* Comprehensive testing: unit, integration, AI behaviour, security, accessibility

* Analytical and problem\-solving oriented;
* Ethical thinker who considers the broader implications of AI implementations;

* Growing every day

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material \- data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.



From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML\-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.



Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.



We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.


### **About the Role**



The Agentic AI Engineering team at Behavox is building the next generation of intelligent automation—AI agents powered by the latest advances in large language models (LLMs). Our mission is to dramatically boost productivity across the company by creating agents that can reason, take action, and seamlessly integrate with our development and business workflows. You will tackle a diverse set of engineering challenges, including designing agentic architectures, orchestrating LLMs with external tools and APIs, and deploying robust, scalable AI systems. As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will work closely with AI researchers, and MLOps to bring innovative agent solutions from prototype to production.



For the right talent, this is a great opportunity because:  

* Pioneer Enterprise AI Integration: You will be at the forefront of applying cutting\-edge LLMs and agent technology to real business operations, leading the development of first\-of\-their\-kind AI solutions that redefine how our teams work. You'll have the freedom to experiment and shape Behavox's approach to AI\-driven productivity.
* High Impact and Visibility: The AI agents you develop will have immediate and tangible effects on the daily work of hundreds of employees. Success in this role means your work will be recognized company\-wide for making a real, measurable difference in productivity.
* Collaborative, Growth\-Oriented Environment: You'll collaborate with a top\-tier team of AI researchers and MLOps experts, working on state\-of\-the\-art technology in a culture that values innovation, experimentation, and learning. It's a unique chance to expand your expertise and drive a strategic initiative without layers of bureaucracy slowing you down.


If you're excited to pioneer agentic AI technology and see your work transform the way people work every day, this is the perfect place for you.


### **What You'll Bring**


* A deep and genuine interest in Behavox as demonstrated by a connection to its mission, marketplace and/or technologies
* Production AI/LLM Application Development: Extensive relevant experience, including building production\-grade LLM\-powered applications or agents

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**We’re Quandri, our mission is to unlock the world’s insurance data so brokerages and agencies can best serve their clients. Our Renewal Intelligence Platform is designed to help brokerages save time, increase profitability, and drive better outcomes for their staff, clients, and business.** 




  





 We saw 3x ARR growth last year and have plans to continue to grow both revenue and our team this year. Named one of
 
 LinkedIn’s Top Canadian Startups
 
 in 2024, we have already made a big impact on the insurance industry. However, what matters most is making our customer’s lives better one renewal at a time. We want you to be a critical part of that journey! We’re a hybrid company, with ⅔ of our team in Vancouver and the rest distributed. For those in Vancouver, we have an office in Gastown that we expect people to be at three days a week. We understand both the advantages of some flexibility around personal lives, and the positive interpersonal effects of in\-person collaboration.
 



  





 Running a profitable personal lines book of business is harder than ever for insurance brokerages. Market conditions, rising costs, talent shortages, and staffing constraints are just some of the challenges that hinder profit margins, scalability, and exceptional client service. Trusted by 5 of Canada’s top 10 brokerages, Quandri is transforming the renewal process with AI\-driven automation, enabling proactive workflows and delivering data\-driven insights.
 



  





 Today’s renewal process is often reactive, with brokers focusing on clients who request help rather than adopting a proactive, data\-driven approach. Quandri is revolutionizing renewals by offering a platform that uses AI and automation to streamline operations. This allows brokerages to retain more business, enhance client and staff experiences, reduce E\&O risk, and boost sales through upselling and cross\-selling.
 



  





 Are you looking to make an impact in your next role? How about transforming an entire industry? At Quandri, we’re unlocking new frontiers in insurance. To do that, we model our culture as a crew of interstellar astronauts. As Quandronauts, we’re committed to building a company that is diverse and multi\-faceted. We’ve raised venture capital from top US and Canadian investors to help us achieve our mission, and are now scaling to achieve this.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 We're seeking an AI Engineer to lead the development of sophisticated AI applications and intelligent systems. You'll be responsible for integrating foundation models, building AI agents, implementing advanced RAG systems, and creating production\-ready AI applications that deliver exceptional user experiences. This role focuses on applied AI development and building intelligent systems that solve real business problems.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




  




* Design and develop AI\-first applications powered by cutting\-edge foundation models.
* Create and deploy intelligent agents capable of complex reasoning and task execution.
* Build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems—including advanced graph RAG implementations.
* Develop conversational and multi\-modal interfaces that enable natural, intelligent user experiences.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing product workflows and help define entirely new product experiences.
* Implement integrations with leading foundation models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, and more.
* Design and execute fine\-tuning strategies to adapt models to domain\-specific use cases.
* Apply advanced post\-training optimization techniques like Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), constitutional AI, and safety alignment.
* Develop reusable prompt engineering frameworks and systems for automated prompt optimization.
* Combine multiple models and agents into ensembles and multi\-agent systems for complex problem solving.
* Build and maintain vector databases and high\-performance semantic search systems.
* Implement state\-of\-the\-art text embedding techniques and similarity matching workflows.
* Design and build knowledge graphs and graph\-based reasoning engines.
* Architect multi\-step reasoning pipelines and tool\-using agents for dynamic workflows.
* Deliver personalized, context\-aware AI experiences that drive real\-world impact.
* Deploy AI systems into production with strong performance, availability, and reliability guarantees.
* Monitor system behavior and quality with observability tooling and analytics.
* Design and implement robust safety mechanisms including content filtering and model alignment controls.
* Continuously optimize inference cost and latency for scalability.
* Build and maintain automated evaluation systems to ensure quality, safety, and alignment in real\-time.



  





**The right person for this role will have:** 




  




* 3\+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, applied AI, or related fields
* Strong proficiency in Python for AI application development
* Solid SQL skills for data retrieval and analysis
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their AI services
* Experience with foundation models and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.)
* Proficiency with AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, etc.)
* Knowledge of vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, pgVector) and embedding models
* Core AI Competencies Experience building RAG systems and knowledge retrieval applications
* Understanding of prompt engineering, few\-shot learning, and in\-context learning
* Knowledge of LLM fine\-tuning techniques (LoRA, QLoRA, full fine\-tuning)
* Experience with text embeddings, semantic search, and similarity matching
* Familiarity with AI agent frameworks and tool\-using language models
* Experience with of AI safety, alignment, and responsible AI development practices



  





**Bonus points if you have:** 




  




* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Mathematic, or related field
* Experience with graph databases and knowledge graph construction
* Knowledge of multi\-modal AI (vision\-language models, speech recognition)
* Experience with AI model evaluation, red teaming, and safety testing
* Familiarity with edge AI deployment and model optimization
* Experience with conversational AI and dialogue systems
* Contributions to AI research, publications, or open\-source AI projects



  





**Our guiding principles:** 




  




* **Customers at the core.** 
 We put the customer at the center of all we do. At a basic level, we believe business success comes down to talking to customers and building something they want. We don’t listen to customers and just take what they say blindly, but we think critically about it and build what they need. Customers are the core of everything we do, and our business exists to serve them. We prioritize their needs over all else within the company.
* **Move with urgency.** 
 There are times when we need to move slowly and deliberately, but we default to acting fast and with urgency. We slow down when necessary, but this should be a deliberate choice. Businesses become more lethargic as they grow, this principle is designed to fight this fact.
* **Be curious.** 
 We understand the world by being curious and asking why. We aren’t satisfied with surface level understanding, and seek a deeper understanding of why things are the way they are. Don’t take someone’s word for it or the answer “because that’s how we do it.” Understand why and dig deep.
* **Excellence in execution.** 
 We know that what separates good from great is a high level of execution. We commit ourselves to excellence in everything that we do, from delivering an amazing product to writing a great email.
* **Act like an owner.** 
 We’re all owners of the business and act like it. We follow through on commitments, own our results and think long\-term.
* **Fight for simplicity.** 
 The law of increasing functional information states that systems evolve to become more complex over time. At Quandri, we believe there is sophistication in simplicity; as such, we intentionally fight for streamlined solutions and are committed to the uncomplicated.



  





**Compensation and benefits:** 




  




* Compensation range of
 **$145k to $200K** 
 annually
* Employee stock options based on experience level
* Comprehensive health benefits, including Lifestyle Spending Account
* 4 weeks of paid vacation per year
* Work anywhere in the world for 60 days of the year



  





**Application process:** 



* Please submit your resume highlighting relevant experience and include a cover letter explaining your interest in the specific role
* Provide links to relevant projects, GitHub repositories, or publications
* Be prepared to discuss technical projects and problem\-solving approaches in interviews



  





 Quandri is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. As an equal opportunity employer, Quandri adheres to Canadian labour laws and does not engage in discrimination based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other status protected under Canadian law.
 



  





 Don’t let imposter syndrome stop you from applying. Great people sometimes don’t have the “right” experience. If you think that you’ll be amazing at this role then we encourage you to apply.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
### **About Behavox**



Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material \- data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.



From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML\-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.



Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.



We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.


### **About the Role**



The Agentic AI Engineering team at Behavox is building the next generation of intelligent automation—AI agents powered by the latest advances in large language models (LLMs). Our mission is to dramatically boost productivity across the company by creating agents that can reason, take action, and seamlessly integrate with our development and business workflows. You will tackle a diverse set of engineering challenges, including designing agentic architectures, orchestrating LLMs with external tools and APIs, and deploying robust, scalable AI systems. As an Agentic AI Engineer, you will work closely with AI researchers, and MLOps to bring innovative agent solutions from prototype to production.



For the right talent, this is a great opportunity because:  

* Pioneer Enterprise AI Integration: You will be at the forefront of applying cutting\-edge LLMs and agent technology to real business operations, leading the development of first\-of\-their\-kind AI solutions that redefine how our teams work. You'll have the freedom to experiment and shape Behavox's approach to AI\-driven productivity.
* High Impact and Visibility: The AI agents you develop will have immediate and tangible effects on the daily work of hundreds of employees. Success in this role means your work will be recognized company\-wide for making a real, measurable difference in productivity.
* Collaborative, Growth\-Oriented Environment: You'll collaborate with a top\-tier team of AI researchers and MLOps experts, working on state\-of\-the\-art technology in a culture that values innovation, experimentation, and learning. It's a unique chance to expand your expertise and drive a strategic initiative without layers of bureaucracy slowing you down.


If you're excited to pioneer agentic AI technology and see your work transform the way people work every day, this is the perfect place for you.


### **What You'll Bring**


* A deep and genuine interest in Behavox as demonstrated by a connection to its mission, marketplace and/or technologies
* Production AI/LLM Application Development: Extensive relevant experience, including building production\-grade LLM\-powered applications or agents
* Expertise in LLM \& Agentic Concepts: Mastery of concepts like retrieval augmented generation (RAG), prompt chaining/Chain\-of\-Thought reasoning, use of memory (short \& long\-term) in AI agents, and tool usage by agents
* Strong Python and Engineering Skills: Fluency in Python programming and familiarity with ML libraries or frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow) as needed
* Cloud \& DevOps Familiarity: Experience deploying and running applications on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)

### **What You'll Do**


* Design and Deploy Autonomous AI Agents: ability to architect AI agents to perform complex tasks by breaking them into smaller steps, and implementing them end\-to\-end from PoC and till production
* Innovate and Drive AI Projects: ability to originate innovative ideas for applying AI agents to real problems
* Apply Latest Research to Improve Systems: competence in staying up\-to\-date with recent developments in the AI/LLM field and incorporating those improvements
* Optimize and Ensure Reliability of AI Agents: demonstrated ability to use engineering tools to improve performance – e.g., optimize an agent's response time or success rate by adjusting how it uses resources
* Technical Leadership and Collaboration: ideally, the candidate would be able to make sound technical decisions, mentor others, and collaborate effectively

### **What We Offer**


* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation with 100% bonus pay already integrated
* Benefits include great health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time\-off policy and flexible work schedule

### **About Our Process**



We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment \- the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.



During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.



The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers.

title: AI Business Unit Leader - Nomi
description:
### **About Nomi AI**


Nomi AI is changing how businesses connect with their customers, patients, students, and employees. We're an AI\-powered conversational platform that goes beyond old\-school surveys. Instead of low completion rates and endless manual follow\-ups, Nomi AI uses smart, two\-way phone conversations to gather deep insights, understand sentiment, and give real\-time, actionable plans. Our goal is to help organizations make smarter, faster decisions by truly understanding the voice of their audience.

### **The Role**


We’re seeking a bold, entrepreneurial CEO / AI Business Leader to lead our AI unit at Nomi. This is a rare opportunity to build from the ground up, shape strategy, validate product\-market fit, and scale a high\-growth AI venture with full autonomy.


If you're energized by AI, early\-stage company building, and want the freedom to create something truly meaningful—this could be your moment.

### **What Your Day Will Look Like**


Business Leadership

* Oversee day\-to\-day operations and strategy of Nomi AI within Valsoft’s AI portfolio
* Develop and execute a growth\-focused roadmap aligned with long\-term goals
* Translate vision into action—own P\&L, go\-to\-market strategy, and org design


Operational Excellence

* Design scalable workflows for onboarding, support, and internal systems
* Define and monitor KPIs across key functions for performance optimization
* Systematize repeatable processes while maintaining startup agility


AI Product \& Technology Leadership

* Rapidly validate ideas—ideally capable of leading/overseeing a PoC in weeks
* Collaborate with AI engineers and users to shape impactful, scalable solutions
* Drive commercialization of AI technologies in real\-world environments


Team Building \& Execution

* Hire, lead, and inspire a team that shares your passion for execution and innovation
* Cultivate a culture of ownership, learning, and speed
* Build the foundation of a company with scale in mind—lean, fast, and bold


Customer \& Market Insights

* Run customer discovery to inform product development and business direction
* Monitor market trends and competitive landscape to stay ahead of the curve

### **About You**

* You’re entrepreneurial at your core—you’ve built, sold, or scaled something from zero to one (or one to ten)
* You’re hungry, young\-at\-heart, and thrive on ownership and autonomy
* You may have a background in top\-tier consulting, high\-growth startups, or founder\-led ventures
* You execute fast—done is better than perfect
* You see ambiguity as fuel—not a blocker
* You have a real passion for AI and its commercial applications
* You don’t need hand\-holding—you lead the charge and make things happen

### **Qualifications**

* Entrepreneurial or startup background highly preferred
* Deep curiosity or working knowledge of AI/ML technologies
* Proven leadership in a high\-growth or early\-stage environment
* Bachelor's degree in Business, AI, Engineering, or related field (preferred)
* Legally authorized to work in Canada
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)

### **Why Join Us?**

* Build from scratch: Lead and scale an AI business from the ground up
* Full ownership: Autonomy to shape vision, team, and trajectory
* Cutting\-edge domain: Work at the frontier of AI innovation
* Entrepreneurial upside: Competitive comp, growth\-based incentives, potential equity
* Supportive ecosystem: Backed by Valsoft’s resources and long\-term commitment

The AI Engineer is responsible for engaging with stakeholders to support the identification, creation, testing, and implementation of new AI tools and solutions that will improve operations and accelerate outcomes to business problems. The role will utilise the Avance AI Framework to identify and categorise relevant use cases which will be prioritised by ROI, technology/data readiness and quality.  

  

Day to day tasks include educating technical and non\-technical users, identification of use cases (via our AI project framework), creating and monitoring POC, MVP, and implementing finalised tools.  

  

This role will require technical engineering proficiency, commercial awareness and a strong growth mindset, as well as the ability to align ideas and the company Technology Strategy with the company and department strategies.  

The position encompasses both technical and business\-oriented responsibilities, including participation in ideation, solution, and design workshops; conducting the relevant assessments; tracking value delivery; and ensuring alignment with commercial requirements (ROI).  

  

**Core Responsibilities:**  

At our core, we are a data\- and trust\-driven organisation. As our AI Lead Developer, your mission is to strategically architect and execute AI capabilities that are secure, explainable, and tightly aligned with our research objectives and customer commitments.  

* **AI Strategy:**
	+ You will define and own our AI development strategy, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, ethical expectations, and regulatory constraints — especially in relation to sensitive or high\-risk data environments.
	+ You are expected to rigorously evaluate the full landscape of AI options — including off\-the\-shelf models, in\-house experimentation, and fully bespoke AI builds — and make evidence\-based recommendations that balance technical viability, commercial outcomes, and budgetary scope.
	+ You will lead the development and deployment of production\-grade AI solutions, ensuring scalability, resilience, and compliance from the outset. This includes prototype pipelines, model training systems, and full\-stack AI integrations.
* **AI Agent Development:**
	+ Design, build, and deploy AI agents to automate tasks, enhance decision\-making, and improve operational efficiency across the organization.
	+ Develop intelligent systems capable of handling complex data inputs and generating actionable insights.
* **AI\-Driven Process Optimization:**
	+ Identify opportunities to integrate AI into existing workflows to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and improve accuracy.
	+ Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into AI\-powered solutions.
	+ You will be a key decision\-maker and technical expert in evaluating the risk, return, and strategic fit of AI initiatives, with the authority to recommend build, buy, or defer pathways based on clear criteria.
	+ You are accountable for managing the trade\-offs between innovation and compliance — advancing new solutions while ensuring we never compromise on privacy or trust.
* **Machine Learning Model Development:**
	+ Develop and implement machine learning models to analyse large datasets, predict outcomes, and optimize business processes.
	+ Apply natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and other AI techniques to solve domain\-specific challenges.
* **Data Management and Integration:**
	+ Design tools that extract, transform, and process structured and unstructured data (PDFs, slides, and more).
	+ Work with large, complex datasets from diverse sources, ensuring data quality and integrity.
	+ Integrate AI solutions with existing systems and databases to enable seamless data flow and real\-time decision\-making.
* **Collaboration and Innovation:**
	+ Partner with scientists, researchers, and business teams to identify AI opportunities and drive innovation.
	+ Stay up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in AI and biotech to ensure the organization remains at the forefront of technology.
	+ You will collaborate closely with our data governance, cybersecurity, and research operations teams to ensure AI systems are technically excellent and legally sound.
* **Performance Monitoring and Improvement:**
	+ Monitor the performance of AI systems and agents, continuously refining and optimizing them for better outcomes.
	+ Provide technical support and training to end\-users to ensure successful adoption of AI tools.
* **AI Operations \& Execution Excellence**

Your role is to deliver AI systems that are reliable, secure, and operationally effective under real\-world constraints.  

* **Emerging Technologies:**

You are expected to keep us not just current — but competitively aware — without being swept up in hype cycles.  

* **Privacy, Data Segregation \& Compliance**

Privacy and trust are foundational — not afterthoughts.  

* **Team Collaboration \& Developer Mentorship**

You will work across functions — and lead from the front.  

* **Quality Control, Experiment Discipline \& Result Reproducibility**

Experimentation is encouraged — but always under discipline  

* **Success Criteria**

You will be considered successful in this role not by the number of models shipped — but by:  

* Your judgment and decision\-making on when to build, test, or integrate AI capabilities.
* The integrity, scalability, and impact of the AI systems you help deploy.
* Your ability to keep us aware of — and ahead of — meaningful developments in the AI space.
* The security, privacy, and legal soundness of every AI workflow under your guidance.
* The clarity, leadership, and discipline you bring to a complex and fast\-moving space.

 **Qualifications, Skills and Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. A Ph.D. is a plus.
* Proven experience in developing and deploying AI solutions, including machine learning models and AI agents.
* Strong programming skills in Python, R, or similar languages, with experience in AI frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit\-learn, Azure ML Studios, Jupyter, or similar
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and AI/ML tools (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).
* Knowledge of biotech, life sciences, or healthcare data is highly desirable, as is awareness of commercial requirements.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
* Experience in data mining, statistical analysis, and dataset management.
* Experience in ITIL and DevOps processes, especially in release and change management.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

To apply, please share an updated CV and one of the team will be in touch should your profile and experience match the needs we are looking for. Due to high volumes of applications, please don't expect an immediate response.

The Agentic AI Engineering team at Behavox is building the next generation of intelligent automation—AI agents powered by the latest advances in large language models (LLMs). Our mission is to dramatically boost productivity across the company by creating agents that can reason, take action, and seamlessly integrate with our development and business workflows. For the right talent, this is a great opportunity because:  

* Pioneer Enterprise AI Integration: You will be at the forefront of applying cutting\-edge LLMs and agent technology to real business operations, leading the development of first\-of\-their\-kind AI solutions that redefine how our teams work. You'll have the freedom to experiment and shape Behavox's approach to AI\-driven productivity.
* High Impact and Visibility: The AI agents you develop will have immediate and tangible effects on the daily work of hundreds of employees. Success in this role means your work will be recognized company\-wide for making a real, measurable difference in productivity.
* Collaborative, Growth\-Oriented Environment: You'll collaborate with a top\-tier team of AI researchers and MLOps experts, working on state\-of\-the\-art technology in a culture that values innovation, experimentation, and learning. It's a unique chance to expand your expertise and drive a strategic initiative without layers of bureaucracy slowing you down.


If you're excited to pioneer agentic AI technology and see your work transform the way people work every day, this is the perfect place for you.


### **What You'll Bring**


* A deep and genuine interest in Behavox as demonstrated by a connection to its mission, marketplace and/or technologies
* Production AI/LLM Application Development: Extensive relevant experience, including building production\-grade LLM\-powered applications or agents
* Expertise in LLM \& Agentic Concepts: Mastery of concepts like retrieval augmented generation (RAG), prompt chaining/Chain\-of\-Thought reasoning, use of memory (short \& long\-term) in AI agents, and tool usage by agents
* Strong Python and Engineering Skills: Fluency in Python programming and familiarity with ML libraries or frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow) as needed
* Cloud \& DevOps Familiarity: Experience deploying and running applications on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)

### **What You'll Do**


* Design and Deploy Autonomous AI Agents: ability to architect AI agents to perform complex tasks by breaking them into smaller steps, and implementing them end\-to\-end from PoC and till production
* Innovate and Drive AI Projects: ability to originate innovative ideas for applying AI agents to real problems
* Apply Latest Research to Improve Systems: competence in staying up\-to\-date with recent developments in the AI/LLM field and incorporating those improvements
* Optimize and Ensure Reliability of AI Agents: demonstrated ability to use engineering tools to improve performance – e.g., optimize an agent's response time or success rate by adjusting how it uses resources
* Technical Leadership and Collaboration: ideally, the candidate would be able to make sound technical decisions, mentor others, and collaborate effectively

### **What We Offer**


* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation with 100% bonus pay already integrated
* Benefits include great health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time\-off policy and flexible work schedule

### **About Our Process**



We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment \- the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.



During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.



The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers.

Du hilfst Deinen Kunden dabei, kritische Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe modernster Technologien zu automatisieren.
   

  

 Dabei sieht jeder Tag bei uns anders aus. In einem hochdynamischen Umfeld mit erfahrenen Kollegen bringst Du Deine Ideen ein – und bist dabei führender Teil eines starken internationalen und vielseitigen Teams. Und das macht richtig Spaß.
   

  

 Klingt interessant? Ist es auch. Wenn Du Deine Erfahrungen bei anderen Kunden oder Märkten einbringen möchtest, sollten wir unbedingt ins Gespräch kommen. CGI ist bekannt dafür, seinen Mitarbeitern ein weites Feld an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten zu bieten. Das zeichnet uns aus – gerade im Vergleich mit den übergroßen Playern. Denn bei uns zählt jeder einzelne Mitarbeiter und das Team.
   

  

 Aufgaben
   

  

* Du bist fachlicher Ansprechpartner für unser Data Science Team, motivierst und leitest unsere Mitarbeiter in Projekten, entwickelst und verantwortest einen optimalen Service für unsere Kunden
* Du konzipierst und entwickelst End\-to\-End KI\-Lösungen für unsere Kunden, die Data Engineering, Modellentwicklung und Bereitstellung der Modelle umfassen.
* Du agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und IT in einer anspruchsvollen und abwechslungsreichen Projektarbeit.
* Mit Methoden der Mathematik, Informatik und Statistik gewinnst Du Informationen aus großen Datenmengen, die für unseren Kunden von Vorteil sein können.
* Wo andere nur einen Datendschungel sehen, erkennst Du Muster, Zusammenhänge und Prozessoptimierungsansätze.


 Qualifikation
   

  

 Du besitzt umfangreiche Erfahrung als Senior Data Scientist und in der Leitung von Entwicklungsteams, hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts\-) Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Physik oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang und bist erfahren in der Konzeption von Lösungsarchitekturen im Data Science / ML Umfeld? Dann sollten wir uns unbedingt kennenlernen.
   

  

 Und wenn Du bei einigen der folgenden Themen mit dem Kopf nickst, dann sollte unser Treffen so richtig spannend werden:
   

  

* Breites Verständnis von Machine\-Learning Verfahren und Algorithmen mit: Classification Methoden (KNN, SVM, Decision Trees, LogReg, etc.), Clustering Methoden (DBScan, KMeans, etc.), Regression Methoden (Lin Reg, LSTMs, etc.)

* Mit den Frameworks / Bibliotheken des Python Data Science Stacks (z.B. Keras, Tensorflow, Numpy, Pandas, sklearn, PyTorch) bist du vertraut.
* Du hast tiefgreifende Erfahrung in einem ML\-Bereich, bspw. Image\-Processing, Audio\-Processing oder NLP
* Du hast Erfahrungen in der Aufbereitung und Analyse von Daten, sowie in der Konzeption und Implementierung von Daten Pipelines.
* Als Machine\-Learning Engineer hast du bereits Erfahrung in der End\-to\-End Entwicklung von KI\-Applikationen gesammelt
* MLOPS Prinzipen zur Behebung von Drift in produktiven Modellen sind dir bekannt, und du kennst dich mit MLOPS Tools zur Dokumentation und Versionierung von Modellen und Artefakten aus (z.B. MLFLOW, Langfuse)
* Du hast Erfahrung im Entwicklungsprozess von Softwareapplikationen (Testing \& Deployment, Source Control) und DevOPS Prinzipien sind dir bekannt
* Du hast Erfahrung mit Docker und in der Entwicklung von REST\-APIs

 Der Faktor Mensch steht bei uns immer im Mittelpunkt – trotz aller Technologie. description:
**About The Job**
 Hopper is continually redefining how people travel, combining a best\-in\-class travel agency with a portfolio of proprietary fintech offerings that give our customers peace of mind when booking travel. More than 100M monthly active users are exposed to our products through our mobile app and a growing list of partners such as CapitalOne, Air Canada, and Spirit Airlines. With a real\-time feed of 50B\+ priced itineraries daily along with more than ten years of history and multiple external data sources, we have unparalleled insight about pricing and demand trends.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to join our growing Fintech Foundation team. We’re responsible for optimizing pricing for all ancillary products we sell, balancing customer demand with the financial risks we take on. We help our product teams deliver new fintech products to market faster, respond rapidly to changing market conditions, run continuous champion\-challenger testing on product construction levers, and maintain our growing portfolio of pricing models across dozens of partners.
   

  

 As a ML engineer you will play a key role in growing our fintech business through delivering and operating innovative pricing solutions at scale across dozens of partners.
   

  

**What Would Your Day\-to\-day Look Like**
* Implementing automated, reusable ML training pipelines.
* Build data ETL pipelines including appropriate feature engineering
* Develop and deploy ML real\-time pricing solutions to production.
* Monitor and optimize for low\-latency and minimal training/serving skew.
* Collaborate with data scientists, engineers and product stakeholders to define and implement relevant solutions.


**An Ideal Candidate Has**
* Strong development skills in Python, Scala, SQL.
* Deep understanding of ML algorithms and frameworks like pandas, sklearn, flyte, TensorFlow etc
* Familiarity with data modeling, software architecture and distributed data processing tools.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


**Perks and benefits of working with us:**
* Well\-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre\-IPO equity packages.
* Hopper covers the cost of employee premiums for private medical and dental coverage.
* Hopper also offers private life and accident coverage.
* Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.
* Access to co\-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work\-from\-home stipend.
* Unlimited PTO.
* Hopper offers a monthly cash allowances for gym memberships and to cover home\-office expenses for a comfortable remote working experience.
* Carrot Cash travel stipend.
* Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
* Open communication with management and company leadership.
* Small, dynamic teams \= massive impact.


**More About Hopper**
 At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world\-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.
   

  

 The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.
   

  

 While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.
   

  

 Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end\-to\-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.
   

  

 Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:
   

  

 Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
   

  

 Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no\-questions\-asked resolutions.
   

  

 Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1\.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
   

  

 Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.
   

  

 Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co\-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
   

  

 Hopper has been named the \#1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the \#3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen\-Z and millennials travelers.
   

  

 Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..
   

  

 Come take off with us!
   

  

 Compensation Range: $150K \- $330K

**About The Company**
**About Cleo**
 At Cleo, we're not just building another fintech app. We're embarking on a mission to fundamentally change humanity's relationship with money. Imagine a world where everyone, regardless of background or income, has access to a hyper\-intelligent financial advisor in their pocket. That's the future we're creating.
   

  

 Cleo is a rare success story: a profitable, fast\-growing unicorn with over $200 million in ARR and growing over 2x year\-over\-year. This isn't just a job; it's a chance to join a team of brilliant, driven individuals who are passionate about making a real difference. We have an exceptionally high bar for talent, seeking individuals who are not only at the top of their field but also embody our culture of collaboration and positive impact.
   

  

 If you’re driven by complex challenges that push your expertise, the chance to shape something truly transformative, and the potential to share in Cleo’s success as we scale, while growing alongside a company that’s scaling fast, this might be your perfect fit.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn to keep up to date with new product features and insights from the team.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Machine Learning Engineers at Cleo work on building novel solutions to real\-world problems. This really does vary but could be: creating chatbots to coach our users around their financial health, creating classifiers to better understand transaction data or even optimising transactions within our payments platform.
   

  

 Ultimately, we’re looking for a brilliant Machine Learning Engineer to join us on our mission to fight for the world's financial health. You’ll be leading technical work within a team of adaptable, creative and product\-focused engineers, who train \& integrate cutting edge machine learning across a variety of products and deploy them into production for millions of users. We understand our customers, we understand their pain, and we are passionate about helping them.
   

  

 Here Are Some Examples, Big And Small, Of The Kinds Of Product Feature Work Our ML Engineers Have Taken Part In Over The Last Year
   

  

* Designed and implemented AI agents to analyse and extract insights from users’ transactional data.
* Developed models to interpret transactional data, enhancing the understanding of users’ finances. Think about your bank statement—how often do you not recognise a transaction on first review?
* Created contextual intent classifiers to understand user conversations with Cleo, enabling tailored and accurate platform responses.
* Engineered ML models to identify and deliver relevant actions to users within Cleo, ensuring a seamless, context\-aware conversational experience.
* Built models to evaluate risk in customer interactions with bank transaction features and user activities.
* Developed optimisation models to improve payment success rates for customers while minimising business costs, tackling this as a two\-sided optimisation challenge.


 Whatever problem you tackle, and whichever team you join, your work will directly impact those most in need, helping to improve their financial health.
   

  

**What You'll Need**
* Excellent knowledge of both Data Science (Python, SQL) and production tools
* Experience building chat products
* A deep understanding of probability and statistics fundamentals
* Big picture thinking to correctly diagnose problems and productionising research
* Top tier communication skills, to be able to partner with Product and Commercial Leaders
* Industry\-leading contributions to your field, communicated through conferences, blogs, talks, or open\-source projects
* 3\+years of experience in data science, machine learning engineering, or related roles
* Excellent knowledge of both Data Science (python, SQL) and production tools
* Strong ability to communicate findings to non\-technical stakeholders
* Experience deploying machine learning models into production; familiarity with Docker containers and container orchestration tools is a plus


**What do you get for all your hard work?**

* Work at one of the fastest\-growing tech startups, backed by top VC firms, Balderton \& EQT Ventures
* A clear progression plan. We want you to keep growing. That means trying new things, leading others, challenging the status quo and owning your impact. Always with our complete support.
* Flexibility. We can’t fight for the world’s financial health if we’re not healthy ourselves. We work with everyone to make sure they have the balance they need to do their best work
* Work where you work best. We’re a globally distributed team. If you live in London we have a hybrid approach, we’d love you to spend one day a week or more in our beautiful office. If you’re outside of London, we’ll encourage you to spend a couple of days with us a few times per year. And we’ll cover your travel costs, naturally.

**About Cleo**
 At Cleo, we're not just building another fintech app. We're embarking on a mission to fundamentally change humanity's relationship with money. Imagine a world where everyone, regardless of background or income, has access to a hyper\-intelligent financial advisor in their pocket. That's the future we're creating.
   

  

 Cleo is a rare success story: a profitable, fast\-growing unicorn with over $200 million in ARR and growing over 2x year\-over\-year. This isn't just a job; it's a chance to join a team of brilliant, driven individuals who are passionate about making a real difference.  Follow us on LinkedIn to keep up to date with new product features and insights from the team.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Senior Machine Learning Engineers at Cleo work on building novel solutions to real\-world problems. This really does vary but could be: creating chatbots to coach our users around their financial health, creating classifiers to better understand transaction data or even optimising transactions within our payments platform.
   

  

 Ultimately, we’re looking for a brilliant Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join us on our mission to fight for the world's financial health. You’ll be leading technical work within a team of adaptable, creative and product\-focused engineers, who train \& integrate cutting edge machine learning across a variety of products and deploy them into production for millions of users. We understand our customers, we understand their pain, and we are passionate about helping them.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Built models to optimise the payment success for our customers and optimising the costs for the business. Think of this as a two\-sided optimisation problem.
